decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core two-component coating know-how into corrosion protection, and with industry turnover growing and the firm holding slack, there is no clear shortfall to trigger dropping it, although it is only mentioned on the website.

The injection pump is close to the established construction-repair offer and is presented on its own page, which signals satisfactory results against aspirations and little reason to search for alternatives.

The material transfer pump fits the firm's material conveying portfolio and can be carried with modest resources, so under favourable industry conditions management keeps it despite its low website visibility.
The fire protection flow monitoring has its own page and supports the firm's digitalization strategy, so management sees it as meeting aspirations and keeps it.
